name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy has seen rapid development in late October–November 2026, with v2.37.2 being the latest release (2026-11-04, https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases/tag/v2.37.2). Key improvements include cross-server UnifiedPush subscriber tracking via a shared database (v2.37.0), persistent daily rate-limit counters that survive restarts and are shared across PostgreSQL-backed clusters (v2.36.0), and security fixes for the Matrix push gateway (v2.35.0). Rate limiting has been significantly improved with Retry-After and RateLimit headers, smarter ban-feed weights, and per-visitor daily windows.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL-2.0 (client) — see repository for details
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in October–November 2026 with active bug fixes and features
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — user database, tiers, tokens, and access control are supported
answers.Is there a hosted cloud version availabl: Yes — ntfy.sh is the official hosted cloud version

breaking_excerpts: v2.36.0 upgrade: everyone's daily counts start over at upgrade — stats_* columns of the user table are zeroed and no longer used
v2.36.0: the whole server config is checked again at startup when base-url or message-size-limit above 4K is set, so a previously-tolerated invalid config now fails at startup
v2.37.0 behavior change: the ntfy_visitors_total metric and 'visitors' stat now count visitors of roughly the last minute instead of the last day, changing its semantics

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a powerful open-source notification library supporting 80+ services but is a library/CLI tool rather than a standalone pub-sub server like ntfy.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notifications and file sharing but is a proprietary cloud service with a restrictive free tier and no self-hosting, unlike ntfy.

alternatives.name: Alertmanager + Webhook
alternatives.review: Alertmanager is better suited for infrastructure alerting pipelines but is far more complex to configure and not designed as a general-purpose pub-sub notification tool like ntfy.
